headline: See your LinkedIn post the way the feed shows it, before you post it
subhead: A free Claude Code mod. Ask Claude for a post like you always do, and a pane in Claude Code shows your draft on a LinkedIn post card, cut where "see more" cuts it.
subhead_secondary: Works in the Claude Code terminal and in the Code tab of the Claude Desktop app, on Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer. It doesn't run in the claude.ai chat.
inside: The fold on mobile and on desktop, so you see where your hook gets cut
A flag on bold, headings and links that LinkedIn shows as raw symbols
Your character count against LinkedIn's 3,000 limit
One tab per draft when you ask Claude for a few hooks
A copy button that strips the formatting before you paste
proof: We run LinkedIn inbound for agency founders. The posts, the comments and the DMs. This mod is the free part: it shows you the feed version of a draft before anyone else sees it.
